subject: Cashflow smoothing: supplier activation and invoice cutoff coordination
messages:
From: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@payflux.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PayFlux vendor info + request for invoice cutoff alignment

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding packet (PayFlux_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a copy of our standard payment preferences. Two items we wanted to align on before activation:

- Invoice cutoff: our billing runs on the 5th/20th of each month; can Redwood consolidate to a single monthly cutoff (20th) to simplify remittance?
- Early settlement option: we can offer a discounted early-pay price if Redwood signs up for accelerated remits (1.0% fee for payment within 15 days).

We’ll also need PO routing instructions so our billing system can automatically populate the PO number on invoices.

I’ve copied Marissa from your procurement team for PO/process questions. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Rohit Patel
Head of Finance Operations | PayFlux Inc.
rohit.patel@payflux.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: PayFlux_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@payflux.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayFlux vendor info + request for invoice cutoff alignment

Hi Rohit —

Appreciate the packet. Quick answers and next steps:

- PO routing: please send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai with the PO number in the subject line; we’ll configure auto-routing once procurement confirms the vendor record.
- Cutoff: procurement typically aligns vendors to our monthly close (end of month), but we can support a 20th cutoff if it maps cleanly into our AP calendar.
- Early settlement: this is managed via finance; I’ve looped Marcus to confirm the feasibility and fee schedule.

Marissa — can you confirm the vendor record checklist and whether the 20th cutoff will cause any reconciliation overhead on your side?

Rohit — attaching the onboarding form you sent to our internal tracker (linked). If you can also provide your W-9, that will speed the setup.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-payflux-onboarding
Attachment referenced: W9 (requested)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayFlux vendor info + request for invoice cutoff alignment

Ava / Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Procurement notes and proposed config: 

1) Vendor record: needs completed onboarding form (received) + signed W-9 + bank ACH remit details. If Rohit can push W9_PayFlux.pdf and ACH details, we can complete KYC checks.

2) Cutoff alignment: we can support a 20th-of-month billing lane as a special invoice lane. It will be treated as a mid-month cycle and will require one minor mapping in our ERP (ETA 2 business days to configure once vendor record is active).

3) Early settlement: Finance has approved an accelerated remit program. Typical commercial terms we offer to vendors are:
   - Net45 (standard)
   - Net30 (upon request, no fee for long-standing partners with a credit history)
   - Accelerated settlement program: vendor accepts a discounted invoice (1.5% fee for payment within 10 business days) or 0.75% for payment within 20 business days.

Rohit — is PayFlux flexible on the early settlement percentage? We can run a 90-day pilot with a reduced fee (1.0%) to evaluate cashflow impact. If PayFlux accepts, we’ll provision the early-pay lane and add the appropriate PO annotations.

Marissa — please confirm the PO creation workflow and whether we should route the first three invoices to my desk for manual approval while we pilot.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment requested: ACH details + completed W-9

From: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@payflux.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@payflux.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayFlux vendor info + request for invoice cutoff alignment

Marcus / Ava —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming:

- We’ll provide W9_PayFlux.pdf and ACH details by EOD today (attached).
- We accept the 20th invoice cutoff and proposed mapping.
- We’re happy to pilot the accelerated settlement program at 1.0% for 90 days; please confirm that payments will be processed within 10 business days of invoice receipt for the pilot.

Attached: Signed_Vendor_Enrollment.pdf (the onboarding form with signatures) and W9_PayFlux.pdf.

If you can provision the vendor lane and create a PO (even a placeholder PO) we’ll begin sending invoices referencing the PO number.

—Rohit
Rohit Patel

rohit.patel@payflux.com

Great — thanks, Rohit. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

- Marcus: procurement will create vendor record and provision mid-month (20th) invoice lane; ETA 2 business days.
- Marissa: please create a placeholder PO referenced DL-58392 and route the first three invoices to Marcus for manual approval during the pilot.
- Finance: we’ll enroll PayFlux in the accelerated settlement pilot at 1.0% (10 business day payment window) for 90 days; please confirm SLA in HubSpot/DocuSign and I’ll send the DocuSign link to Rohit to capture PO acceptance.

Rohit — once the placeholder PO is issued, please start sending invoices to invoices@redwood.ai with the PO number in the subject and the 20th cutoff in the invoice footer. We’ll monitor throughput and share cost/benefit after 30/60/90 days.

Appreciate the speed here — copying the HubSpot deal for record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/58392
